title: The best thing about MondayMotivator was the way it changed my life
html:
Hello! Kia ora! Et Bonjour (I’m learning French)!

I’m back!

You might remember me from such MondayMotivators as The Cracked Pot or 5 things I’ve learned from 10 years of writing the MondayMotivator.

You might also remember I started the MondayMotivator in ’04, and didn’t miss a Monday for over 10 years. Unfortunately, it got to a point where the love of writing had gone. So, I stopped… and luckily had two young children to keep me very busy because I missed it.

It's my great pleasure to announce the return of Bob - the Stickman (and maybe his family will make an appearance) and the reappearance of the MondayMotivator.

So on Mondays from now on, wake up, have a cup of tea, pack the kids’ lunches and see what Bob has to say before heading off to work.

I do hope you’ll stay on the list but if you’d rather not I understand - too many emails right?
